name: Roselith
summary: Roselith is crafted from solid elm with a light gray veneer that highlights the natural beauty of the wood. The seat is upholstered in finely textured fabric, bringing a soft contrast to the clean structure of the frame. With its balance of warmth and refinement, it presents a timeless silhouette designed to complement contemporary living.
